# The man page is generated by the maintainer (it used to come from txt2tags
# under MOO_DEV_MODE) and committed to the tree; the build only installs it.
#
# The html manual that used to live in help/ was written for medit as it was in
# 2010 and had been wrong for years, so it is gone; Help -> Help opens the
# project page instead.

install(FILES built/medit.1 DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_MANDIR}/man1")
